title: A 'joyful' designer who worked on 'elevating the beauty of women': Valentino dead at 93
summary: Speaking on FRANCE 24, fashion journalist Dana Thomas pays tribute to the legendary Valentino, a 'joyful and joyous' fashion designer who worked on 'elevating the beauty of women'. Valentino Garavani passed away on Monday aged 93 at his home in Rome.
